question.prompt: If point \(P(a,b)\) is in the fourth quadrant, in which quadrant is point \(Q(-b,a)\)? (Enter the number 1, 2, 3, or 4.)

solutions.explanation: \(P\) is in the fourth quadrant, so \(a>0\) and \(b<0\). Thus, \(-b>0\) and \(a>0\). Both coordinates of \(Q\) are positive, so it is in the first quadrant.
solutions.title: Track the coordinate signs
